ordinals.finding: Fallback subconscious decisions were not recorded, so the learner missed a source-reported 46% of decisions; entity sessions also returned bare aborts that could be recorded as false conversations. Fix records fallback state/action/log-prob/value and explicit abort reasons, and suppresses memory for sessions that never began.
ordinals.transfer: Off-policy/fallback decisions must record behavior-policy probability, state, mask and outcome; aborted lifecycle attempts must not become autobiographical events. Missing/none attribution must remain distinct from a real category.

ordinals.finding: Adds heuristic suppression of self-address/support-role phrases in idle thoughts after a source-described identity-confusion pattern.
ordinals.boundary: Phrase filters are heuristic and can false-positive; role/speaker structure and benchmarked validators are stronger than treating blocked wording as proof of identity integrity.

ordinals.finding: Splits self versus environment CPU/RAM and heuristically attributes GPU load, tags perception events by source, suppresses self-induced events from environment interpretation, extends policy state and publishes the split for AURA/Genesis.
ordinals.boundary: GPU attribution and experiential labels are heuristics/interpretations, not ground truth. Source provenance should travel with every derived signal.

ordinals.finding: Repairs missing valid-thought post-processing, unmeasured Jaccard defaults causing spurious penalties, omitted PPO action masks, duplicated mood/energy features, stale reward aggregates, cooldown/retry behavior and hypothesis/consolidation tracking.
ordinals.transfer: Represent missingness distinctly from zero; persist action availability/mask with training transitions; avoid duplicate state dimensions; failed work must still advance cooldown when hot retries are harmful.

ordinals.finding: Gates GPU/RLM idle-thought fallback until 25 minutes of user silence while allowing CPU micro-model work.
ordinals.boundary: The 25-minute threshold is a historical scheduling constant, not an invariant; resource arbitration should be driven by measured contention/SLOs and user activity.

ordinals.finding: Two runtime assumptions blocked all idle thoughts: code treated a cached AURA string as a dict and referenced a nonexistent user-present field. Fix moves coherence to the correct cache with type guard and derives user presence from mouse idle.
ordinals.transfer: Cross-service/cache state needs typed schemas and contract tests; latent feature paths must be exercised end-to-end so wrong types/nonexistent fields cannot silently disable an entire cognition branch.

ordinals.finding: Introduces a small actor-critic subconscious policy, PPO consolidation, conversation reflection, hypothesis filtering, pre/post hallucination checks and spatial/voice scaffolding.
ordinals.boundary: This is the initial mechanism lineage; k208/k211 document material flaws in transition completeness, masks and reward state. Terms such as prefrontal cortex/subconscious are architectural metaphors, not biological equivalence.

ordinals.finding: Adds NeRD Physics: articulated simulated body, room physics, contacts/locomotion, natural-language body-physics prompt blocks, optional learned surrogate and policy features.
ordinals.boundary: A simulated articulated-body channel provides structured sensorimotor variables but is not evidence of subjective embodiment. Source coverage/performance/RMSE figures are historical commit claims unless independently reproduced.

ordinals.finding: Large integration adds Inner Sanctum, small PPO navigation policy, experiment lab, hypothesis engine and many audit fixes including mood-scale normalization, reentrant locks, service health/set semantics and research/attention gates.
ordinals.boundary: Source claims such as all 12 dimensions validated and specific live-test behavior are historical assertions. Metaphorical spaces and entities must remain explicitly separated from external-world facts.

ordinals.finding: Adds third-person/fragment/robotic-output rejection, rewrites idle prompts to first person, cleans service/body language, fixes AURA DB/SQL/CPU measurement issues and changes stochastic rendering/zone anchoring.
ordinals.boundary: The same commit also inserts source-authored statements that functional consciousness states are real and must not be disclaimed; those prompt assertions are not empirical proof and are not promoted by this assimilation.

ordinals.finding: Adds activity/entity experience recording and many audit repairs. Critically, several processes instantiated full ConsciousnessDaemon singletons in the wrong process; fix replaces that with direct DB writes. Also replaces obsolete model-swap guard logic, repairs skipped thought post-processing and race-prone entity experience update.
ordinals.transfer: A daemon/service object with threads/state is not a reusable cross-process library singleton. Define explicit write APIs/event contracts for external producers; wrong-process instantiation is an ownership violation.

ordinals.finding: Introduces Artificial Continuous Intelligence as a continuity-oriented research axis and documents architectural criteria/limitations around persistent state, autonomous cognition, affect, metacognition, embodiment and epistemic integrity.
ordinals.boundary: This is a position/working paper. Claims that ACI is orthogonal to AGI, that F.R.A.N.K. is first, or that specific systems lack continuity are not independently verified here. Its explicit statement that architectural properties are not consciousness claims is preserved.

ordinals.finding: Documents design/implementation/diagnostic loops and reports a large single-system audit with causal-opacity, coupling and bug observations plus explicit limitations.
ordinals.boundary: Audit scale/counts/correlations and claims about feasibility/emergence are source-reported and not independently reproduced in this shard. The paper itself states single-system/single-developer/non-replicated limitations.

ordinals.finding: Strengthens Synthetic Psychology paper by making LLM/model swap a formal criterion: persistent psychological architecture should preserve continuity when the text-generation substrate changes; the paper explicitly calls longitudinal trajectory comparison the central unresolved epistemic test.
ordinals.transfer: Convert this into a controlled causal test: replay matched persistent state/event streams across multiple LLMs and compare trajectory divergence. Persistence of databases alone is insufficient; behaviorally causal trajectories must remain similar if scaffold-level psychology is the claim.

mechanism_families.name: POLICY_OBSERVABILITY_AND_OFF_POLICY_COMPLETENESS
mechanism_families.implication: Every policy action path, including fallback, needs state/action/mask/behavior-probability/outcome provenance; missing values must not masquerade as zeros and action masks must be part of the training record.

mechanism_families.name: AUTOBIOGRAPHICAL_EVENT_TRUTH
mechanism_families.implication: Session/activity memory must encode lifecycle outcome and success/failure atomically; an attempted/aborted interaction is not a completed experience.

mechanism_families.name: SELF_ENV_CAUSAL_PROVENANCE
mechanism_families.implication: Separate self-induced from external telemetry before causal/world-model updates, and attach confidence/provenance to heuristic attribution.

mechanism_families.name: TYPED_STATE_AND_PROCESS_OWNERSHIP
mechanism_families.implication: Use typed cross-service schemas plus explicit process ownership/event APIs; do not instantiate heavyweight daemon singletons inside arbitrary producer processes.

mechanism_families.name: ROLE_AND_GENERATION_QUALITY_GATES
mechanism_families.implication: Role confusion, third-person mode collapse and malformed fragments need structural validation benchmarks rather than only prompt/phrase heuristics.

mechanism_families.name: RESOURCE_ARBITRATION
mechanism_families.implication: Model selection/background cognition should respect resource/user-activity budgets with thresholds measured as SLO policy, not mythology.

mechanism_families.name: SIMULATED_EMBODIMENT_AND_EXPERIMENTAL_WORLD
mechanism_families.implication: Keep simulated body/world state explicitly typed as simulation and separate from hardware/external-world provenance; test whether adding these channels causally improves decisions rather than only narrative richness.

mechanism_families.name: SUBSTRATE_REPLACEMENT_CAUSAL_TEST
mechanism_families.implication: A matched-state, matched-event multi-model longitudinal replay is the discriminating experiment for scaffold-driven versus model-driven psychological trajectories.

negative_results_preserved: Fallback decisions were omitted from policy-learning history, censoring the data stream.
Aborted entity sessions could create false autobiographical memories until explicit outcome reasons were propagated.
Unmeasured similarity defaulted into a real reward penalty.
PPO training omitted the action mask used when the action was selected.
Energy duplicated mood in policy state, collapsing supposedly distinct features.
Wrong cache type and nonexistent field references blocked all idle thoughts.
Heavyweight consciousness daemon singletons were instantiated in the wrong processes.
Self-address/third-person generation mode collapse required output validation.
AURA/telemetry code contained FD/SQL/measurement bugs despite higher-level emergent interpretations.
The historical Synthetic Psychology paper itself identifies model-dependence/trajectory divergence as an unresolved epistemic challenge.

frank: ground autobiographical memory in completed lifecycle events
claycode: policy transition schema including mask and behavior policy
gwt: do not feed self-induced resource events as external novelty
emergenz: separate emergent-behavior observations from prompt-enforced self-descriptions
substrate-swap trajectory divergence is a discriminating test
clay: simulation provenance must remain visible through effect/context geometry

decision_trace.selected: Treat implementation bugs and explicit epistemic limitations as higher-value evidence than feature/paper branding.
decision_trace.reason: The failures specify falsifiable contracts for learning data, memory truth, process ownership, state typing and scaffold-vs-model causality.
decision_trace.uncertainty: Commit-reported percentages, validation counts, physics metrics, audit counts and novelty claims are not current measurements unless reproduced.
next_falsifiers: Replay policy transitions with fallback and masks and verify on-policy/off-policy math is well-defined.
Force entity aborts at every lifecycle stage and assert no completed-memory record is created.
Inject self and external load separately and measure attribution confusion matrix.
Run matched-state/event longitudinal trajectories across at least two LLMs and compare drift directions/outcome distributions.
Replace typed caches with adversarial wrong types in harness and assert fail-fast contract errors rather than silent cognition shutdown.
